title: Camunda 8.8.0 before 8.8.47, 8.9.0 before 8.9.29, 8.10.0 before 8.10.10, and 8.11.0-alpha1 contain an insecure…
description: Camunda versions 8.8.0 prior to 8.8.47, 8.9.0 prior to 8.9.29, 8.10.0 prior to 8.10.10, and 8.11.0-alpha1 have an insecure deserialization vulnerability in their persistent web session feature. This feature stores session attributes as Java-serialized data and deserializes them without applying an ObjectInputFilter, allowing attackers with write access to the web session index to execute arbitrary code by crafting malicious serialized objects. The vulnerability can be exploited if an attacker can write to an unauthenticated Elasticsearch cluster used by Camunda's docker-compose setup. The flaw is tracked as CVE-2026-77230 and has a high severity CVSS score of 8.1.
